scope: Normalization audit for official fripSide audio discography released from 2014-01-01 through 2020-12-31.

policy.releases: Best albums, the PC game compilation, and the hybrid 15th-anniversary special album crossroads normalize to compilation. Editions with identical normalized audio sequences merge; editions with different audio sequences split. Video-only bonuses are ignored.
policy.songs: Tie-in annotations and typography variants are removed from canonical titles. Repeated compilation appearances reuse the same version slug. Instrumental/off-vocal, TV-size, vocal-part, year, IS, and crossroads variants are modeled as song versions.
policy.uncertainty: A null parent/relation with a non-null uncertainty_reason means the official discography wording is insufficient to assert the relationship safely.

edition_groups.reason: These editions have the same normalized audio disc and track sequence; video bonuses and packaging do not create a separate audio release record.
